vocabulary.meaning_en: thankful
vocabulary.example: I'm very grateful for your help.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an opinion about what someone should do
vocabulary.note_ar: اسم غير معدود: some advice / a piece of advice. الفعل: advise
vocabulary.example: Could I ask you for some advice?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give time or something you can do without
vocabulary.example: Could you spare me a few minutes?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stop someone while they are talking or working
vocabulary.example: Sorry to interrupt, but the client is here.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a plan to reach a goal
vocabulary.example: We need a new strategy for stock management.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to have earned something because of your actions
vocabulary.example: You worked hard. You deserve it.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very worried and not able to think clearly
vocabulary.example: I'm in a bit of a panic about the deadline.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very happy
vocabulary.example: I'd be delighted to help.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a planned piece of work
vocabulary.example: She has led many projects.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a chance to do something
vocabulary.example: I'm very grateful for this opportunity.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something a person is very good at
vocabulary.example: Numbers are not my speciality.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who helps with general office work
vocabulary.example: Our office assistant answers the phone.

vocabulary.meaning_en: happening or used now
vocabulary.example: First, look at the current system.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a list of steps you need to do
vocabulary.example: Draw up an action plan of tasks.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to prepare and write a plan or document
vocabulary.example: Let's draw up a list of tasks.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to start using an idea in real life
vocabulary.example: Now we need to put the plan into practice.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a building where goods are stored
vocabulary.example: Take the lift down to the warehouse.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to go and speak to someone about something
vocabulary.example: Approach him in the right way and he'll help.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to answer someone in an angry way
vocabulary.example: Don't worry, he won't bite your head off.

vocabulary.meaning_en: unable to continue because you don't know what to do
vocabulary.example: If you're stuck, just ask for help.

fine_lines.title: Telling vs asking
fine_lines.explanation_ar: عندما تحتاج مساعدة اطلبها ولا تأمر بها. You must help me أمر غير مهذب، أما I would be most grateful if you could... فطلب مهذب جدًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: When you need help, ask, don't tell. "You must help me" sounds like an order. "I would be most grateful if you could..." is very polite.

examples.sentence: I would be most grateful if you could help me.

fine_lines.title: advice vs advise
fine_lines.explanation_ar: advice اسم غير معدود (نصيحة) ويُنطق بصوت s. advise فعل (ينصح) ويُنطق بصوت z.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "Advice" is an uncountable noun (/s/ sound). "Advise" is the verb (/z/ sound).

examples.sentence: She advised me to make an action plan.

expressions.phrase: I would be most grateful if you could give me some help.
expressions.meaning_ar: سأكون ممتنًا جدًا لو استطعت مساعدتي.
expressions.meaning_en: a very polite way to ask for help
expressions.example: I would be most grateful if you could give me some help with this report.

expressions.phrase: Please could I ask you for some advice?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنني من فضلك أن أطلب منك نصيحة؟
expressions.meaning_en: a polite way to ask for advice
expressions.example: Please could I ask you for some advice about the project?

expressions.phrase: I know you're busy but could you spare me a few minutes of your time please?
expressions.meaning_ar: أعلم أنك مشغول، لكن هل يمكنك منحي بضع دقائق من وقتك من فضلك؟
expressions.example: I know you're busy but could you spare me a few minutes of your time please?

expressions.meaning_en: used before you speak to someone who is busy
expressions.example: Sorry to interrupt, but your visitor is here.

expressions.phrase: Where do you think I should begin?
expressions.meaning_ar: من أين تظن أنه عليّ أن أبدأ؟
expressions.meaning_en: asking for advice on the first step
expressions.example: It's a big job. Where do you think I should begin?

expressions.meaning_en: a friendly reply when someone asks for help
expressions.example: Of course, always happy to help.

expressions.meaning_en: used to thank someone for advice
expressions.example: Thanks for your advice. I'll try it today.

grammar.title: Very polite requests: I would be grateful if you could...
grammar.explanation_ar: أكثر الصيغ تهذيبًا: I would be (most) grateful if you could + فعل أساسي. وأيضًا Could you spare me + وقت. استخدم could وليس can لتكون أكثر لطفًا.
grammar.explanation_en: A very polite form: "I would be (most) grateful if you could + base verb". Also "Could you spare me + time". Use "could", not "can", to sound softer.
examples: I would be most grateful if you could check my report.
Could you spare me five minutes?
Please could I ask you a question?

questions.question: Which is the MOST polite way to ask for help?
choices: I would be most grateful if you could give me some help.
questions.explanation_ar: صيغة I would be most grateful if you could هي الأكثر تهذيبًا.
questions.explanation_en: "I would be most grateful if you could" is the most polite.

questions.question: Complete: Could you ___ me a few minutes of your time?
questions.explanation_ar: spare me a few minutes = امنحني بضع دقائق.
questions.explanation_en: "Spare me a few minutes" means give me some time.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: Could I ask you for an advice?
Could I ask you for some advices?
Could I ask you for some advice?

questions.question: Complete: I would be most grateful if you ___ help me.
"He won't bite your head off" means...
choices: He won't be angry with you
questions.explanation_en: It means he won't answer you angrily.

questions.question: What did Denise advise Anna to do first?
questions.explanation_ar: نصحتها بالنظر في النظام الحالي أولًا.
questions.explanation_en: She told her to look at the current system first.
